ref_file_title: BR06 - The Security of Triple Encryption and a Framework for Code-Based Game-Playing Proofs
note: Verified against vendor/cryptobib entry EC:BelRog06 (EUROCRYPT 2006, pp. 409-426, doi 10.1007/11761679_25 — suggested cryptobib_key: EC:BelRog06). Full version eprint 2004/331 under the title 'Code-Based Game-Playing Proofs and the Security of Triple Encryption' (confirmed via WebSearch snippet). Names the PRP/PRF Switching Lemma, exhibits the conditioning flaw in the standard proof (observed by Kohno), and gives the game-playing proof with bound $q(q-1)/2^{n+1}$.

Verified against vendor/cryptobib EC:BelRog94 (EUROCRYPT 1994, LNCS 950, pp. 92-111, doi 10.1007/BFb0053428; cryptobib records the proceedings year as 1995, the literature cites BR94). Introduces OAEP. Role improvement rather than original: BR94's IND-CCA argument is incomplete (Sho01a) and the RSA-OAEP result is FOPS01. cryptobib_key: EC:BelRog94.
